extracted.intended_audience: writers and readers of creative nonfiction interested in learning about the lyric essay
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for composing a lyric essay — a form of creative nonfiction that borrows poetic techniques and flexible forms to explore an idea or lived experience. Focuses on craft features, structures, and source-mixing that characterize the lyric essay.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of poetic techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: A lyric essay uses the techniques of poetry, including compression, sound play, white space, formal innovation, non-linear narrative, and juxtaposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These poetic techniques are applied to prose to shape language, pacing, and associative meaning; they help the piece explore an idea or experience more elliptically than straight narrative. (Original phrasing: "uses the techniques of poetry, including compression, sound play, white space, formal innovation, non-linear narrative, and juxtaposition")

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploration of an idea or personal experience
rubrics_metrics.description: The lyric essay explores an idea or an experience in the writer’s life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form is oriented toward probing or meditating on a topic drawn from the writer’s life rather than straightforward reportage or strictly plot-driven memoir.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible/collage structures
rubrics_metrics.description: Lyric essays may be structured as collage or mosaic, as braided or woven narratives, as 'flash' snapshots.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Writers may assemble fragments, images, and short scenes into a larger associative form rather than constructing a conventional linear arc. (Original phrasing: "structured as collage or mosaic, as braided or woven narratives, as 'flash' snapshots")

rubrics_metrics.name: Hybridization with other forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Lyric essays may be wedged within the carapace of other forms such as instruction manuals, rejection letters, lists, or maps.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form often hides or frames lyric material inside other genres or document types, using the parent form to shape voice, constraints, and irony. (Original phrasing: "wedged within the carapace of other forms such as instruction manuals, rejection letters, lists, or maps")

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of images
rubrics_metrics.description: Lyric essays may make use of images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Including visual material is an accepted strategy for adding associative layers, texture, or contrast to the prose; images can be integrated as part of the collage/mosaic approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mixing research with personal experience
rubrics_metrics.description: They often rely on research in addition to personal experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effective lyric essays can weave factual or researched material together with memoir or reflection to complicate authority and add depth. (Original phrasing: "They often rely on research in addition to personal experience.")

rubrics_metrics.name: Readerly demands / density
rubrics_metrics.description: Lyric essays typically make greater demands on the reader than other types of creative nonfiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expect complexity, associative leaps, and non-linear logic; the form may require more active interpretation and may not be immediately accessible to all readers. (Original phrasing: "Typically, they make greater demands on the reader than other types of creative nonfiction, so for some, they are an acquired taste")
